Chapter 1 
Section 1, Mammalia
Tetrapod Classification (p.13)
1. Monoceros thevetii: the species in India is about 40 inches long, and has red hair after reaching maturity.
(just the color of the candy from Fiona. Though I didn't ... just for reference)
The local species in England is smaller, about 20-35 inches long, and has dark brown hair.
(Monoceros thevetii may be included by the classification test in the future. Remember: stroke the spot 3 inches below the back of its neck, but keep it less than 4 times in case of panic)

2. The horn consists of a structure of 3 layers: (refer to the shell of tridacna gigas)
-  Keratin layer: the external layer. Major component: chitin. Gray in most cases, it grows along with its owner;
-  Prism layer: the middle layer. Major component: calcium carbonate crystal
-  Pearl layer: the internal layer, composed of horizontally aligned calcium carbonate slices (imagine the crispy roast fish slice you can get at the left window of the Second Canteen)

trails.title: Plan of Escape Route
trails.description: This could be a desperate attempt. You must take it seriously.

items.text: Burning Tears
Joint Committee of SF

items.speaker: Z
items.text: We've investigated the event in the school.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Incited by the Manus pamphlets, a girl named Vertin assembled about 20 students to sing a revised version of the school song at the Parade Ceremony.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Principal Richard and the safety supervisor failed to dissuade them, and thus deployed guards, Dumbitter Potion, and non-lethal weapons.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: During the conflict, Vertin's lap was accidentally shot by a non-lethal weapon. She fell into a coma.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: With the treatment provided by the school clinic, she was discharged after making a full recovery. She should be back to school today.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: ... What a bad move.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Whose move?
Constantine shakes her head. She doesn't intend to respond.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: What was their appeal?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: They wanted to know the outside world ... especially, the "Storm."

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: This Vertin, is the one that we know of?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The kid who stretched her arms outside the front gate to catch a frog during the "Storm"—THAT Vertin?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: If I recall correctly, the report described her arm didn't show any signs of change after getting soaked in the "Storm."

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Nor inflammation, nor decaying, nor deformation, nor any other diseases.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: She's special. Makes me think of her mother.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: ... I've never met her mother. Such a pity.
Constantine returns to her chessboard. Her eyes glimmer in the dark.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Please inform Richard that the school is now under special supervision. The committee will take charge from here.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: What's the plan now?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We have made a bad move.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: They've made it such a scene, which will inevitably place us on the opposite side of those kids.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: They sowed a seed of doubt in those children.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: What happened this time will have a long-lasting effect, and Manus will not sit tight by it.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: And I ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I need Vertin to grow.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The way I prefer.
School of Primary Defense of Mankind

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: When an Olitiau gets nervous, it may attack people.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Whenever this happens, we need to lower our body as much as we can and act friendly to avoid irritating it ...
An opened notebook is passed quietly from the other side of the table.
It is a copy of class notes for this week.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I ... I think you may find this helpful.
Thank you.

branch.speaker: Sonetto
branch.text: You're welcome. Are you feeling better now?

branch.speaker: Sonetto
branch.text: I heard you were in a coma for two days.

items.text: It's rare that you would come and speak to me.
items.edge_label: It's rare that you would come and speak to me.

branch.speaker: Sonetto
branch.text: I may have misunderstood you. I'm sorry ...

branch.speaker: Sonetto
branch.text: How are you feeling now? I heard you were in a coma for two days.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm fine. It doesn't hurt so much now. It hurt more when the tear gas burnt me.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto drops her head. She seems out of words.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The song ... was beautiful.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Glad to hear you say so.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But we won't sing it anymore. I think other students are still locked in the guardhouse ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Yes. I heard it's dreadful in there ... I went to visit with some food but was turned away by the instructor.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: They will be out next week ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: They are welcome to borrow my notes.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you for your kindness.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I hope they will have the chance to use them.
TO BE CONTINUED…
